name: rendr
description: Record and edit video with Rendr from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the local MCP server inside Rendr, an open-source app that records and edits screen video in one place. Claude can list capture sources, start and stop recordings, and add zoom punch-ins driven by the cursor telemetry captured alongside the video. The editing tool surface is declared but still being built — those tools return an explicit not_implemented error rather than pretending to succeed.
